info.name: Starshipit API
info.description:
Looking to build an integration? Our API allows you to incorporate the intelligence of Starshipit into your platform with minimal integration effort. Built by developers for developers. Starshipit provides a simple, but powerful shipping API for you to easily create orders, generate labels, display rates, manage orders and more. # Getting Started Here’s a quick rundown of what you need to know about working with the Starshipit API. ## What do I need to start? 1. Starshipit account, Starshipit API key and Subscription Key 2. At least one enabled courier in your Starshipit account **Starshipit account:** You’ll need to sign up for a Starshipit account to get an API key. You’ll also need to enable at least one courier to be able to use the rates at checkout request. **Starshipit API key:** To make requests to the API, an authentication token is required. To view your API key log in to your Starshipit account, then go to Settings > API. You can generate a new token here. This is the StarShipIT-Api-Key. **Subscription key:** To make requests to the API, a subscription key is required. To generate your subscription key log in to your Starshipit account, then go to Settings > API. You can generate a new subscription key here. This is the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. # API Rate Limits Our Developer subscription allows you to make two requests per second. Our Production subscription allows you to make twenty requests per second. This subscription requires approval. If you exceed these rates, you'll receive a ‘429 Too Many Requests’ error. # Use Cases #### Shipping using Starshipit API with the Starshipit interface: 1. Push orders into Starshipit via [Create Order API (a)](#abcadf5c-9793-47b3-a2cb-d650c666d84d) from your eCommerce, inventory, warehouse management or other platform. 2. Staff log in to Starshipit and fulfil orders from the Starshipit interface. 3. Staff manifest orders using the Starshipit interface. 4. (Optional) Using Starshipit [Webhooks (b)](#1400272c-4c43-4740-9190-17684beee0fc) retrieve your tracking numbers from Starshipit. #### Shipping using Starshipit API with a third-party or no interface 1. Push orders into Starshipit via [Create Order API (a)](#abcadf5c-9793-47b3-a2cb-d650c666d84d) from your eCommerce, inventory, warehouse management or other platform. 2. Trigger label generation via the [Create Label Print API (b)](#b6bc3576-a43f-4992-86d8-8fdf57f872f6). This will return the label file(s), and the tracking numbers associated with the shipment. Customer can update their orders/shipments in their platform with tracking. 3. Manifest shipments via the Starshipit [Manifest Orders API (c)](#4774c2b5-22a9-41ba-848c-fc0b872b1a39). **Example of a 3PL using a WMS without its own eCommerce platform integrations** 1. Orders are imported into Starshipit using one of our pre-built integrations. 2. WMS imports order details from Starshipit via our [Get Order API (a)](#0aef707f-e2f5-493a-a382-8235c00c9c18). 3. Users pick order and make any necessary changes in their WMS (e.g. change weight). 4. The order is edited in Starshipit via our [Update Order API (b)](#fffefde7-2198-4e38-ae33-283792fd8321). 5. From the WMS the user can print a courier label by using the [Create Label API (c)](#b6bc3576-a43f-4992-86d8-8fdf57f872f6) call which will return a label. 6. Manifest Shipments via the Starshipit [Manifest Orders API (d)](#4774c2b5-22a9-41ba-848c-fc0b872b1a39). 7. Tracking info can then be retrieved from Starshipit using the [Tracking Details API (e)](#a655a3b4-ea39-42c4-acb4-d868ad40dc47) call. # Best Practices ## Batch requests where possible To optimize the performance and efficiency of API interactions, batch your requests whenever possible. For example, instead of sending individual requests for each order, use the `Update Orders` or `Create Orders` endpoints to update or create multiple orders in a single request. # Filters Some requests allow you to filter the orders returned. This parameter is specified in the following format: \[FILTER_COLUMN\]:::\[VALUE\] Multiple filters can be specified, please seperate these by comma ','. For example, a legal filter can look like: Order:::12345,State:::NSW Source:::Shopify Some filters can be pre-fixed with '!' to return orders that do not meet the condition. For example, !Country:::Australia will return all orders not from Australia. | FILTER_COLUMN | Description | Type / format | Example Filter Value | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Order | Filter for a specific order number | String | Order:::1419 | | Name | Filter for a specific 'To Name' | String | Name:::John Smith | | Address | Filter for valid addresses | 'valid' | Address:::valid | | Date | Filter for shipped_date, if order_status is shipped. | \[OPERATOR\]\[DATE_STRING\]

Allowed OPERATORs:
\>=
\>
<=
<

DATE_STRING format:
dd MMM yyyy
MMM yyyy

If the OPERATOR is not specified, the date is exactly matched. | Date:::>=MAY 2024

Date:::19 MAY 2024

Date:::<=5 JUN 2023 | | Source | Filter for integration source. Integrations are specified by ID, account specific integration ID or by name, and multiple can be specified by seperating by semi-colon ';'. | String or Int | Source:::25
Source:::25;26
Source:::123456
Source:::Shopify | | State | Filter orders by state. If you wish to filter by multiple states, you must specify the State filter for each. | String | Source:::NSW

Source:::NSW,Source:::VIC | | Country | Filter orders by country. If you wish to filter by multiple countries, you must specify the Country filter for each. | String | Country:::Australia
Country:::Australia,Country:::New Zealand | | Carrier | Filter orders by carrier. If you wish to filter by multiple carriers, you must specify the Carrier filter for each. | String | Carrier:::StarTrack | | Service | Filter orders by carrier service / product. If you wish to filter by multiple services, you must specify the Service filter for each. | String | Service:::EXP | | Status | Filter orders by Order Status. If you wish to filter by multiple Order Statuses, you must specify the Status filter for each. | String \[Delivered, In Transit\] | Status:::Delivered | | SKU | Filter orders by SKU. If you wish to filter by multiple SKUs, you must specify the SKU filter for each. | String | SKU:::ABC123 | | SingleSKU | Filter orders by SKU, where orders only contain a single SKU. If using this filter, only orders with single SKUs that match the filter will be returned.
If you wish to filter by multiple single SKUs, you must specify the Single SKU filter for each. | String | SingleSKU:::ABC123 | | Writeback | FIlter orders by Writeback status. | String | Writeback:::Up to date | | Weight | Filter orders by weight | \[OPERATOR\]\[INTEGER\]

Allowed OPERATORs:
\>=
\>
<=
<

If no OPERATOR is specified, the weight is exactly matched. | Weight:::>=5

Weight:::5 | | ShippingMethod | Filter orders by Shipping Method. If you wish to filter by multiple Shipping Methods, you must specify the Shipping Method filter for each. | String | ShippingMethod:::AusPost Express Intl | | ShippingDescription | Filter orders by Shipping Description. If you wish to filter by multiple Shipping Descriptions, you must specify the Shipping Description filter for each. | String | ShippingDescription:::Express | | Tag | Filter orders by Tag. If you wish to filter by multiple Tags, you must specify the Tag filter for each. | String | Tag:::Urgent |

request.description:
Get a list of all unshipped orders (default: orders updated in the last 24 hours)

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Description | **Example Value** | **Accepted values** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| since_order_date (optional) | Show orders created after date in UTC (date-time in RFC3339 format) | 2024-05-27T06:00:00.000Z |  |
| since_last_updated (optional) | Show orders recently updated after date in UTC (date-time in RFC3339 format) | 2024-05-27T06:00:00.000Z |  |
| ids_only (optional) | Show all unshipped order_ids | false | true |
| limit (optional) | Amount of results (default: 50) (maximum: 250) | 50 | 1, 2, 3, ..., 250 |
| page (optional) | Page to show (default: 1) | 1 | 1, 2, 3, ... |

## List Orders (Unshipped) Response

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| orders | list of orders | List of unshipped orders details ([Full Order Model](#full-order-model)) |
| order_ids | list of order_ids | List of unshipped order_ids (only present if `ids_only` is set to `true`) |
| total_pages | integer | Total number of pages available |
| success | boolean | Determines whether the request was successfully submitted |
| errors | object list | List of detailed errors [(Error Model) ](#error-model) (only present if the request resulted in an error) |

request.description:
## What is a webhook?

Webhooks (callbacks) are event driven executions of code to send data from one application to another. For example, a webhook is a push notification from an email server sent to your phone.

## How it works

Starshipit can send webhook requests when we receive tracking updates from your couriers for your orders. You can specify a notification endpoint URL were Starshipit will send these requests.

Use the notification endpoint URL to receive our webhook data and trigger a certain event in your own application. For example, send an order update email to your customer or update the order status in your database when ‘OutForDelivery’ tracking status is received.

The notification endpoint URL needs to be built to accept the POST request that returns HTTP 200 OK response and the URL can be set in Settings > Customer Notifications.

## Webhook JSON data definitions

| Attribute  | Type | Description |
| :------------- | :------------- | :------------- |
| order_number | string | The identifier of the order pulled from source eCommerce platform. |
| carrier_name | string | Name of the courier used for shipment delivery. |
| carrier_service | string | Courier product service used for shipment delivery. |
| shipment_date | datetime | The date when the label was generated for the shipment. |
| tracking_number | string | Courier tracking number. |
| tracking_status | string | Last tracking status from the courier. |
| last_updated_date | datetime | Last tracking updated date from the courier. |

## Tracking Statuses
* Printed
* Dispatched
* InTransit
* OutForDelivery
* Delivered
* PickupInStore
* AttemptedDelivery
* Exception
* AwaitingCollection
* Cancelled

This POST request is used to create tracking only orders. It expects a payload containing an array of orders with their respective details such as name, order number, carrier, and tracking number.

### Request Body

The request body should be in raw format and contain a JSON object with an array of orders. Each order should have the following parameters:

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name (optional) | String | The name of the customer |
| order_number (optional) | String | Reference number for the order |
| carrier | enum CarrierName | The enum of the carrier this order was shipped with |
| tracking_number | string | The tracking number for the shipment |
| country (optional) | string | The country name. If provided, will be used for calculating machine learning ETD |
| postcode (optional) | string | The destination postcode. If provided, will be used for calculating machine learning ETD |
| carrier_service_code (optional) | string | If passed through, this will be used for calculating Machine Learning ETDs |

### Response

Upon successful processing of the request, the API responds with a JSON object containing all orders that were created with their order numbers and their corresponding tracking numbers as values. Additionally, the response includes a `success` boolean indicating the status of the request.Example

``` json
{
    "orders": {
        "398667087": "XYZ-92312-VSDV-24814",
        "398667099": "NCA-21938-KASL-12314",
        "398667108": "MOX-53215-AJVV-12395",
        "398667112": "BZH-12841-ASGB-12451"
    },
    "success": true
}

 ```

# Error Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |

| building (optional) | string | Building name of the pickup address (max length: 100) |
| company (optional) | string | Name of company that the parcel is being sent from (max length: 100) |
| street | string | Street number and name of the pickup address (max length: 100) |
| suburb | string | Suburb of the pickup address (max length: 100) |
| city (optional) | string | City of the pickup address (max length: 100) |
| state (optional) | string | Regional, provincial or county name of the pickup address (max length: 100) |
| post_code (optional) | string | Postal or zip code of the pickup address (max length: 10) |
| country | string | The country name of pickup address (min length: 2, max length: 100) |

# Destination Details Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | Contact name of the receiver (max length: 100) |
| email (optional) | string | Contact email address of the receiver (max length: 100) |
| phone (optional) | string | Contact phone number of the receiver (max length: 100) |
| building (optional) | string | Building name of the delivery address (max length: 100) |
| company (optional) | string | Name of company that the parcel is being delivered to (max length: 100) |
| street | string | Street number and name of the delivery address (max length: 100) |
| suburb | string | Suburb of the delivery address (max length: 100) |
| city (optional) | string | City of the delivery address (max length: 100) |
| state (optional) | string | Regional, provincial or county name of the delivery address (max length: 100) |
| post_code (optional) | string | Postal or zip code of the delivery address (max length: 10) |
| country | string | The country name of delivery address (min length: 2, max length: 100) |
| delivery_instructions (optional) | string | Delivery instructions for courier (max length: 100) |
| [tax_numbers](#tax-numbers-model) (optional) | list | List of receiver tax numbers |
| tax_number (optional) | string | Recipient tax number (max length: 20) |

# Create Order - Order Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| order_date (optional) | datetime | The date when the order was created in UTC |
| order_number | string | The identifier of the order pulled from source e-Commerce platform (max length: 50) |
| reference (optional) | string | Customer's reference (max length: 50) |
| shipping_method (optional) | string | Delivery method name (max length: 100) |
| shipping_description (optional) | string | Delivery method description (max length: 100) |
| shipping_freight_value | double | The value of the freight being shipped |
| signature_required (optional) | boolean | Determine whether signature is needed on delivery |
| return_order (optional) | boolean | If true, only the return label will be generated |
| currency (optional) | string | Currency code for the order value (max length: 3) e.g. AUD |
| [sender_details](#sender-details-model) (optional) | object | Sender address and contact details |
| [destination](#destination-details-model) | object | Shipping address and contact details |
| [items](#create-order---item-model) (optional) | list | Item list containing the order item details |
| [packages](#create-order---package-model) (optional) | list | Package list containing the parcel details |

# Create Order - Item Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| description (optional) | string | Product name or description |
| sku (optional) | string | Product code or SKU (max length: 50) |
| tariff_code (optional) | string | The harmonized system code that indicates the type of this order item (max length: 18) |
| country_of_origin (optional) | string | The country in which this item was manufactured (max length: 50) |
| quantity (optional) | double | The number of product ordered |
| weight (optional) | double | Unit weight of the product in kilograms (kg) |
| value (optional) | double | Unit price of the product |
| bin_location (optional) | string (250 characters max) | The bin location of the product |
| mid_code (optional) | string | The manufacturer name of the product |
| model (optional) | string | The model of the product |
| material (optional) | string | the material of the product |
| usage (optional) | string | the usage of the product |
| brand (optional) | string | the brand of the product |
| barcode (optional) | string | the barcode of the product |

# Create Order - Package Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| weight (optional) | double | Physical weight of the parcel in kilograms (kg) |
| height (optional) | double | Height of the parcel in meters (m) |
| width (optional) | double | Width of the parcel in meters (m) |
| length (optional) | double | Length of the parcel in meters (m) |

# Update Order - Order Model

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| order_id (read-only) | integer | The unique numeric identifier for the order |
| order_date | datetime | The date when the order was created in UTC |
| order_number | string | The identifier of the order pulled from source e-Commerce platform (max length: 50) |
| reference | string | Customer's reference (max length: 50) |
| carrier | string | The carrier that will be used when creating shipment |
| carrier_service_code | string | Carrier service code for delivery |
| shipping_method | string | Delivery method name (max length: 100) |
| shipping_description | string | Delivery method description (max length: 100) |
| shipping_freight_value | double | The value of the freight being shipped |
| signature_required | boolean | Determine whether signature is needed on delivery |
| currency | string | Currency code for the order value (max length: 3) e.g. AUD |
| [sender_details](#sender-details-model) | object | Sender address and contact details |
| [destination](#destination-details-model) | object | Shipping address and contact details |
| [items](#update-order---item-model) | list | Item list containing the order item details |
| [packages](#update-order---package-model) | list | Package list containing the parcel details |
| [metadatas](#meta-data-model) | list | Additional meta data for the order |
| status | string | The order status |
